description:
About Vercel:

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 

 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. 

 About the role

 As a Software Engineer on Vercel’s Website team, you’ll build and own the software behind vercel.com and our public web experiences. Your work will span React and Next.js applications, shared libraries, APIs, and the services that power forms, analytics, content and more.

 You’ll work alongside engineers and design engineers to make our websites fast, accessible, reliable, and easier to build on. You’ll partner with marketing, data, security, and framework teams to turn business needs into maintainable software, investigate production issues, and improve the systems other teams use every day.

 We’re looking for someone who enjoys moving between the browser and the server, making architectural decisions with peers, and carrying work from an open-ended problem through rollout and ongoing ownership.

 This is a hybrid role with 3 in-office days per week in New York City.

 What you'll do

 
 Build and maintain full stack features and shared services for Vercel’s websites, including form submission, content integrations, and analytics.

 Design APIs and data contracts that connect browser experiences with backend and third-party services. Handle validation, retries, duplicate requests, and upstream failures.

 Measure and improve loading, rendering, and navigation performance while preserving accessibility and accurate event tracking.

 Turn repeated implementation work into reusable libraries, clear interfaces, documentation, and tools that engineers and coding agents can use independently.

 Improve website security and privacy with the teams that own those requirements, including shared security policies and consent behavior.

 Investigate production issues using logs, traces, and browser tools. Add meaningful verification and monitoring, and follow fixes through deployment.

 Shape technical approaches with your teammates, ship changes in focused increments, and share responsibility for code review, migrations, and the long-term health of the website.

 
 What you need

 
 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production web applications.

 Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, with hands-on experience shipping React and Next.js applications.

 Experience writing server-side application code, designing APIs, integrating external services, and reasoning about data flow and failure handling.

 A practical understanding of browser behavior, web performance, accessibility, and how server rendering and caching affect a website.

 Experience debugging production problems and choosing tests and instrumentation that give you confidence a change works.

 The ability to turn ambiguous requirements into a scoped plan, explain tradeoffs, and carry the work through implementation and rollout.

 A collaborative approach to technical decisions and code review. You can give useful feedback, incorporate other perspectives, and make your work understandable to the people maintaining it.

 Comfort using AI-assisted development tools while understanding, reviewing, and validating the code you ship.

 
 Bonus if you

 
 Have built shared libraries, SDKs, developer tools, or infrastructure used by multiple applications.

 Have worked on analytics, event pipelines, experimentation, forms, or consent systems.

 Have experience with CMS integrations, technical SEO, or migrations in a large web codebase.

 Have deployed applications on Vercel or contributed to open source.

 
 Compensation & Benefits:

 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity.

 Inclusive Healthcare Package.

 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

 Flexible Time Off.

 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000 - $294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. 

 
 Disclosures: 

 
 Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.

 Equal Opportunity:  Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.
